title: Norml Changelog
audience: Developers preserving project decisions across sessions
pitch: Record verified changes and decisions so future developers can understand the current project state.
problem: Recent commits and chat context do not automatically preserve why a decision was made.
The package updates existing project records and compresses older routine entries while retaining durable decisions, security fixes and breaking changes.
commands: Compress the older routine changelog entries

flow.d: Read existing docs and verified diffs/session evidence.
Merge same-day changes and preserve tagged decisions.
Update current architecture and applicable migration status.
Report changed files and any compression.

items.name: Verified change log
items.desc: Dated entries grouped by area with rationale.

items.name: Older routine compression
items.desc: Protect decisions, integrations and security/breaking changes.

items.name: Publish or commit
items.desc: Logging alone does not authorize distribution.

items: Never treats planned work as completed or invents estimates.
Preserves other authors and concurrent updates.
No automatic commits, notifications or external publishing.
